context: Pharmacodynamic and pharmacokinetic study of oral Curcuma extract in patients with colorectal cancer. extracts, particularly the dietary polyphenol curcumin, prevent colon cancer in rodents.
target: In view of the sparse information on the pharmacodynamics and pharmacokinetics of curcumin in humans, a dose-escalation pilot study of a novel standardized Curcuma extract in proprietary capsule form was performed at doses between 440 and 2200 mg/day, containing 36-180 mg of curcumin.
